newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu unchanged at close, trading dull.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu unchanged at close, trading dull.

text.p: 1300 GMT - The leu ended the week at 7,000/7,100 to the dollar, unchanged from morning levels, on a market which traders said was quiet after the May Day holiday and ahead of the weekend.
* Operators said they expected the leu to open next week close to Friday's closing quote.
* They said trading had been dull throughout the day though the market had been liquid in both the leu and dollars.
* Money market rates stayed flat at 100-105 percent.
* According to latest central bank data, volume on the interbank market was $19.8 million on Wednesday, when overall trading was $41.7 million.
* Leu-dollar rates at licensed money changing bureaux stuck to 6,800/7,000.
